strengths: High initial emotional intensity and direct camera address can capture quick attention.
Simple talking-head format is easy and cheap to produce.
concerns: Format relies almost entirely on spoken dialogue rather than visual storytelling.
Dark and moody visual tone conflicts with Royal Match's bright, playful aesthetic.
rejection_reasons: Heavy reliance on spoken audio monologue makes international translation and sound-off viewing difficult.
Lack of clear visual puzzle mechanic or actionable problem to bridge into gameplay.
adaptation_idea: A character directly addresses the camera in a humorous, exaggerated panic about King Robert's impending castle disaster before gesturing to an interactive puzzle to fix it.
